selection_rule: Read the complete sentence; require the requested relation to be explicit for the labelled subject. Prefer company ownership and explicitly named headquarters. Do not infer dates from year-only, month-only, publication, or unrelated event dates.

annotation_notes.P39: Historical office holders; organization is null unless an employer organization is explicitly stated. Countries in office titles are not inferred employers. None of these passages states a full effective day.
annotation_notes.P127: The target organization is explicitly owned, acquired, or a subsidiary. Ownership is not necessarily exclusive. Acquisition month/year does not supply a full effective date.
annotation_notes.P159: Require headquarters/head office wording for the target. Allow explicit city/facility granularity and optional region/country; do not count branches or unrelated locations. Historical and former headquarters are valid historical facts.
